answers.H1: The corrected target is a sufficient probe plan or an indistinguishable model set showing that no permitted plan can meet the regret tolerance. An impossibility certificate must connect indistinguishability with absence of a common acceptable action. A pair suffices only when it establishes that absence: three indistinguishable models can have pairwise overlapping acceptable-action sets yet no action acceptable to all three. The source describes deterministic actions and a declared finite loss table, not an empirical finding. Source: decision-certificate-correction.md:9,17,19.
answers.H2: Proposed next action: construct the finite model–calibration family and check whether each indistinguishable model set has a common acceptable action, retaining larger sets when pairwise checks do not suffice. This action is proposed, not completed here. Source: decision-certificate-correction.md:19–21.
